name: context-saver
description: Saves context without losing quality: trims long command output (full copy kept), skips repeat reads of unchanged files, and steers compaction

maxOutputChars.title: Trim command output over (chars)
maxOutputChars.description: Bash output longer than this is trimmed to head, tail and error lines; 0 turns it off

dedupeReads.title: Skip repeat reads
dedupeReads.description: Answer a re-read of an unchanged file range with a pointer instead of the text

steerCompaction.title: Steer compaction
steerCompaction.description: Tell the summarizer to keep decisions, tasks, file:line refs and rules
